blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Coach Yeng Guiao insisted that Rain or Shine had all the intentions of getting a win over Magnolia amid the impression that it avoided an early playoff showdown with TNT in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup. Wednesday’s 107-103 defeat to the Magnolia Hotshots at Ynares Center in Antipolo prevented the Elasto Painters from securing the No. 1 spot in Group B and a best-of-five date with the Tropang 5G in the crossover quarterfinals. “We’re used to facing TNT and we’re used to being beaten by TNT so it will not matter,” Guiao said. “And if you want to become champion, […]...
